## Example 4.6 · Water remaining {#fm6-example-4-6-ab .fm-slide }

A water tank containing 15 000 L has a small hole that reduces the amount of water by 6% per hour.

a) Find the amount of water after 2 hours

b) Find the amount of water after 5 hours

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 15 · Example 4.6 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
The booklet specifies a constant-percentage model; do not infer constant litres per hour or make a physical claim about every real leaking tank. (a) $15000(0.94)^2=13254$ L. (b) $15000(0.94)^5=11008.560336\approx11008.56$ L, or about 11 009 L if rounding to whole litres. Retain precision in calculator working.
:::
